mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.2% over the past month indicates labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings slowdowns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal housing sector contraction that weakens consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contractions (INDPRO below 105.0), manufacturing output weakness signals economic slowdown that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls increase exceeding 100k consistently supports consumer spending growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100k, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and residential investment (RSAFS) indicate broad economic weakness that precedes equity market downturns, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production expansions (INDPRO above 108.0), manufacturing growth signals robust economic activity that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 108.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
